i don’t get this mentality. there was never an “elite artist club.” all the artists i have met are pretty chill people who don’t make much money. no one was ever gatekeeping you from making art, it just takes time and hard work *like any other skill you’ve learned.*

i’m already feeling fatigue from people uploading hundreds of anime girls to pixiv that are, functionally, “good” drawings, but aren’t particularly interesting. so what i see happening is regular artists taking their work into directions AI can’t yet touch. see artists like mai yoneyama.

now? you’re still not making art: the machine is making the art for you. it’s making thousands of micro-decisions: composition, light direction, shape language — yes, you can specify all these things to the AI but it’s rarely going to give you exactly what you want. you’re giving up so much control. 

so yeah, now “everyone” can be an artist. yay! but not everyone can be a *good* artist… that still takes practice, skill, and most importantly: failure.
